metaCatalog.noCatalogLinkedDesc: Connect your Meta business account so you can import your products from Meta Catalog to your store.
metaCatalog.permListCatalogs: View the list of catalogs available to your business account
metaCatalog.permImportSelected: Import only the products you select
metaCatalog.chooseCatalogDesc: Choose the catalog you want to link to your store and import its products. Sync settings become available after choosing a catalog.

metaCatalog.noProductsInCatalog: There are no products in this catalog.
metaCatalog.statusNewMetaToSouqlink: New products from Meta to SouqLink
metaCatalog.statusNewSouqlinkToMeta: New products from SouqLink to Meta
metaCatalog.toggleAutoImportNew: Automatically fetch new products from Meta Catalog
metaCatalog.toggleAutoImportNewDesc: When a new product is added to the catalog, it will automatically be imported into SouqLink as a draft.
metaCatalog.toggleUpdateFromMeta: Update SouqLink products when edited on Meta
metaCatalog.toggleUpdateFromMetaDesc: When a linked product is edited within Meta Catalog, the changes are applied to the corresponding product in SouqLink. Example: if the product's price or quantity changes in Meta Catalog, the corresponding product in SouqLink will be updated.
metaCatalog.manualFetchNote: You can fetch updates manually from the product page.
metaCatalog.inboundFutureNote: ⏳ There is no engine yet that automatically pulls updates from Meta — importing new products and updates in this direction are saved as preferences only, and will actually take effect in a later development phase.
metaCatalog.toggleAutoExportNew: Automatically publish new SouqLink products to Meta Catalog
metaCatalog.toggleAutoExportNewDesc: When a new product is added and published in SouqLink, it will also be created in Meta Catalog.
metaCatalog.exportDraftsRuleNote: ⚠️ Drafts will never be published automatically — a product is only published automatically after it becomes active/published within SouqLink.
metaCatalog.toggleUpdateFromSouqlink: Update Meta products when edited on SouqLink
metaCatalog.toggleUpdateFromSouqlinkDesc: When a linked product is edited within SouqLink, the changes are sent to the corresponding product in Meta Catalog. Example: if the product's price or quantity changes in SouqLink, the corresponding product in Meta Catalog will be updated.
metaCatalog.manualPublishNote: You can publish the product or send its updates manually from the product page.
metaCatalog.outboundWorksNote: ✓ This direction is actually working across the site — when a published product is saved, it's sent to Meta automatically according to the options above. You can also manually sync all your published products right now:
metaCatalog.twoWayWarning: ⚠️ Enabling automatic updates in both directions may cause conflicts if the product is edited in Meta and SouqLink at the same time.
metaCatalog.inboundSavedFutureNote: The inbound direction settings (Meta → SouqLink) were saved, but the automatic sync engine for this direction will be implemented in the next phase. The SouqLink → Meta direction already works in practice.
metaCatalog.errorCheckingConnection: An error occurred while checking. Make sure you're signed in and try again.
metaCatalog.confirmDisconnectDesc: Your Meta account will be disconnected from your store. Previously imported products will not be deleted, their "Imported from Meta" badge will not be removed, and nothing will be deleted from Meta Catalog itself.
metaCatalog.changeCatalogDesc: Changing the catalog will not automatically delete or move products previously imported from the current catalog. Do you want to continue?
